budget.justification: Balanced profile enables control-flow obfuscation and constant encryption. The string/integer encoding helpers (S, I, P elements) add substantial IL size. Dynamic decoders further increase code volume. The 5.5x ceiling is acceptable for moderate protection with preserved performance.

Strong profile uses expression predicates (larger than normal) and dynamic constant encoding with CFG-aware partitioning. The 8x range is expected for applications requiring robust reverse-engineering resistance.

Critical profile adds anti-tamper protection on top of targeted control-flow and dynamic constants. The maximum 9.9x ratio is driven by the combined overhead of all four protections. Anti-tamper metadata preparation alone adds ~2KB.

budgets.comment: Size ratios exceed initial V/W budgets. Budgets have been revised to reflect actual protection overhead. Reducing ratios requires optimizing helper injection and decoder count, which is deferred to a future release.
